# FORMA — Three.js Math Lab

> Seventeen interactive, locally rendered math and physics examples, including Fields Medal teaching topics and recent geometric constructions. Use actual screenshots and captured parameters to identify visual effects, then inspect the scene and pure-math source.

## Entry points

- [README](README.md): Bilingual overview, compact screenshot gallery, offline usage.
- [AI guide](docs/AI_GUIDE.md): Retrieval and source navigation.
- [Examples](docs/EXAMPLES.md): All 17 rendered examples with source links and model limits.
- [Fields and new structures](docs/ADDITIONS.md): Seven additions, research dates, original papers, and model boundaries.
- [Machine-readable manifest](docs/screenshots/manifest.json): Scene IDs, bilingual descriptions, image/raw URLs, parameters, seeds, cameras, formulae, sources, and SHA-256 checksums.
- [Architecture](docs/SDD.md): Registry, scene adapter, rendering, resource lifecycle, build.

## Implementation

- [Catalog](src/catalog.js): navier, vortex, quantum, dunes, sparks, ocean, kissing, kakeya, maxcut, hat, real-kakeya, boltzmann, torus-knot, moduli, noperthedron, e8, matroid.
- [Experiments](src/experiments/): Three.js implementations, definitions, controls, presets, citations.
- [Math](src/math/): Independently testable calculations.
- [Exact data](data/): Published coordinates and weighted graph fixtures with upstream notices.
- [Offline bundle](dist/manifest.json): Artifact metadata and included experiments.

## Interpretation

- [N–S model](docs/NS_MODEL.md): Finite geometric illustration; not a PDE or formal-proof reproduction.
- [Constructions](docs/CONSTRUCTIONS.md): Exact construction provenance and verification.
- [Research](docs/RESEARCH.md): Dated source claims, classic models, and visualization approximations.
- [Validation](docs/QA_REPORT.md): Tests and browser measurements with their limits.
- [Third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): Bundled upstream licenses and attribution.
